primitives.name: Phase-Conditioned Play Prediction
primitives.verbatim_quote: Improvement experiment Beyond the paper: (1) conditioning the predictor on play-phase (pre-snap/snap/post-snap) mask tokens instead of generic mask tokens — the paper's mask tokens are phase-agnostic; NFL plays have rigid phase structure that should sharpen target prediction.

primitives.assumptions: NFL play structures exhibit distinct temporal phases that improve predictive fidelity when explicitly modeled.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when phase information is ignored, leading to ambiguous or noisy predictions.

layer2.mapping: Derives from AdjFuse architecture with added phase-conditioned attention heads.
layer2.telemetry: Reduction in masked-frame RMSE compared to baseline models using generic masks

reasoning_traces.think:
The core insight lies in adapting methodologies rather than adopting absolute numerical benchmarks. The DCA metric ensures contextual consistency across domains, while the GSE task demands attribution over summation—measuring how much individual contributions deviate from aggregate outcomes. This necessitates a shift from total point forecasting to per-player stat attribution under identical protocols. Phase-conditioned prediction introduces structured temporal awareness into models, leveraging NFL’s rigid play phases to refine predictions. Relative coordinate encoding captures spatial relationships more accurately than fixed grids, enhancing AdjFuse's ability to model relational structures inherent in football. These primitives form a coherent foundation for both GSI’s conformal inference and GSE’s situational reasoning.
